diagnosis_summary: Rock confirmed and closed this issue with commit 40986f7974645dc42f57bdab567ccbfe77b449f3 and recorded the fix in the v19.3 release notes. Location Detail recomputed named-location feature visibility from the live edit value of Name. Temporarily clearing Name therefore reclassified an existing named location as address-only and hid the named-location fields, including the field needed to continue editing. The fix snapshots existing-record and original-name state when editing begins and bases visibility on that stable state.
workaround_summaries: Upgrade to a package proven to contain the stable edit-state fix. Before upgrade, replace the existing name without leaving the field temporarily blank, and cancel rather than save if the form hides fields; do not change location type or related records to work around the client-state defect.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether the installed Location Detail edit panel preserves the originally loaded named-location state and whether named locations exist, without saving or changing a location.
prerequisites: Know the installed Rock version or source revision.
Have read-only access to aggregate Location metadata.

steps.title: Check the Location Detail implementation
steps.instructions: Confirm whether the installed client bundle contains commit 40986f7974645dc42f57bdab567ccbfe77b449f3 or equivalent stable isExistingLocation and hadNameWhenEditingBegan values captured from the originally loaded bag.
steps.expected_if_affected: Named-location feature visibility is recomputed directly from the live editable Name value.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Visibility uses the original edit state, or the installed package contains the confirmed fix.
evidence_to_record: stable original edit state present yes or no

steps.title: Count named-location exposure
steps.instructions: Return only the aggregate count of locations with a nonblank Name. Do not return location IDs, names, addresses, campuses, or attributes.
steps.probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS NamedLocationCount FROM [Location] WHERE [Name] IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM([Name])) <> ''
steps.expected_if_affected: The count is greater than zero and the installed client lacks the stable edit-state fix, establishing possible exposure without reproducing the UI defect.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The count is zero, or the installed client contains the confirmed fix.

limitations: A named-location count does not prove that a user encountered the client-state defect.
Do not save a production location to reproduce this issue; interactive reproduction belongs in an isolated environment or must end with Cancel and no network save.

context.scope: editing an existing named location in the Obsidian Location Detail block
exact Location Detail named-location visibility revision
official release-note fix; verify exact package inclusion
